fields.summary: Autonomous plan run (no owner) for change set 01M732D2. Run 01M72YSG (change set 01M71G46) failed review/code because its builder's binary wrote v5 log entries and the code check runs rhiza check in-process with the installed binary, which reads v4. Following the #417 decision (code-check-leaves-reference-to-self-check: no worktree build in the code check; make self-check in CI judges with the branch build), the planner settled that the change set serves m4-runs-hold-up and that the code check stops failing newer-format entries the run's branch adds since its merge-base, through an explicit check option, leaving them to make self-check. Nothing was asked of the owner.
fields.title: Code check and newer-format log entries, autonomous plan
